changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'security' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RuleAssignment') BEGIN create table security.RuleAssignment ( Id uniqueidentifier constraint DF_Security_RuleAssignment_Id default(newsequentialid()) not null, RuleId bigint not null, AssetTypeId int not null, AssetId bigint sparse, UpdatedBy int not null, UpdatedOn datetime not null, constraint PK_Security_RuleAssignment primary key clustered ( Id asc ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Security_RuleAssignment') BEGIN create nonclustered index [IX_Security_RuleAssignment] ON [security].[RuleAssignment] ( RuleId asc, AssetTypeId asc, AssetId asc ) END
